notes: Owner's manuals: account_required (Owner's Portal / My Garage login, VIN-linked; the public page only says to log in). No US owner's manual PDF for Outlander / Outlander PHEV / Outlander Sport was found on mitsubishicars.com by site search. Warranty & Maintenance Manuals (US & territories; they contain the maintenance schedules) are public: the portal's warranty screen flow (select model year -> Next; no login) lists Salesforce Files public links on mmna-ssb.my.salesforce.com (Mitsubishi Motors North America org 00D5e000002Fqtd) for MY2017-2025; MY2014-2016 show coverage tables only, no downloads. Those links open an HTML viewer, so they were verified in the browser (viewer shows 'Adobe PDF', file name, page count); for 2019 the public download endpoint was also Range-checked (206 application/pdf). Direct PDF copies of many of the same booklets are on www.mitsubishicars.com/content/dam/.../what-drives-us/warranty/ (found by site search; Range-verified 206 %PDF); where both exist the DAM PDF is the url and the portal link is in alt_urls. Outlander line includes Outlander PHEV (US sales from MY2018). Lines/years are mapped from booklet titles (multi-model booklets repeated per line). Non-US note: Mitsubishi Motors Canada publishes owner's manual PDFs openly on mitsubishi-motors.ca (e.g. /content/dam/mitsubishi-motors-ca/en/manuals/outlander/15_Outlander_English.pdf, 16_Outlander_English.pdf) - Canadian editions, seen in search results only, not verified and not included.
